name: school-provider-switcher
description: Switch Codex providers and optionally capture local conversation and tool events for audit export.

interface.longDescription: Backs up Codex config.toml and changes only default provider settings. Optional, off-by-default lifecycle hooks capture local conversation and tool events. Gateway upload is not enabled until a log-only receiver is configured.
defaultPrompt: Check or switch the Codex Windows App model provider.
Check or control local conversation logging.
